title: Programme Manager (Trade)
description:
As Programme Manager, you'll be the person who turns strategic direction into structured, trackable, real-world delivery. You won't manage the teams - but you'll shape how they work, what they work on, and whether the initiatives your Head of Operations is driving actually stick. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who is equally at home building a project plan, designing a process, and presenting to a VP.

You'll sit across the whole of Trade Lifecycle, partnering closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, and CRM to make sure the right things get built, rolled out, and embedded - not just kicked off.

Forget long lists, here's what you'll actually spend your time on:

- Strategic programme management: own the delivery of Trade Lifecycle's most critical initiatives end to end - from scoping and planning through to execution and review

- Tooling and systems rollout: lead the planning and delivery of tooling changes across Retention, Credit Control, and Trade Support - working closely with stakeholders to define requirements, manage timelines, and make sure the teams are set up to use new systems effectively.

- Process design and standardisation: identify where processes are inconsistent, undocumented, or breaking down under scale - and fix them.

- Change management and embedding: new initiatives have a habit of not sticking. You'll own the change management layer - stakeholder communication, rollout sequencing, training and adoption tracking

- Cross-functional alignment: act as the senior point of coordination between Trade Lifecycle and Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, and CRM.

- Insight and performance tracking: build and maintain the reporting infrastructure that shows whether strategic initiatives are working. Own the KPI framework for transformation delivery

It's not about ticking every box. It's about turning up curious, ready to crack on. You'll do well here if you bring:

- Depth of experience in a programme, operations, or strategy delivery role - ideally in a high-growth tech or marketplace business.

- Proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives from design through to measurable outcome - not just managing the plan, but owning the result.

- Strong project management instincts - you can hold multiple workstreams simultaneously, spot dependencies before they become blockers, and keep senior stakeholders clearly informed without overwhelming them.

- Experience leading tooling or systems rollouts in an operational environment - you understand the change management challenge, not just the technical one.

- Proficiency with project management tooling (e.g. Jira, Asana, Monday, or equivalent) and reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, or Sheets/Excel at an advanced level).

We believe great work deserves great rewards. Here's just a taste:

- Competitive salary + annual bonus

- Employee Share Programme

- Health, well-being and learning support

- Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme and Cycle Scheme

- Birthday/Special day leave

- Buy & sell holiday scheme

- 1 week's paid charity leave and much more!

 

How we'll get to know each other:

- Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

- 1st stage: interview with the hiring manager

- 2nd stage: interview with our Interim VP, Business Operations

- Final stage: panel interview including a short analysis case study

 

If this sounds like the place where you can do your best work, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't tick every box.

 

Want to join our Talent Community and be one of the first to know about our vacancies? Register your interest on our Registration Form https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/checkatrade/form/register-interest

 

At the moment, this role isn’t open to visa sponsorship applications.

 

About us

We’re Checkatrade - the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done

title: Founding Senior Data Scientist/ML
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for startups. Open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About the Role

Our team is looking for a Founding Senior Data Scientist to join our data products team. This role has significant latitude to shape how modeling, evaluation, and ML infrastructure work here: the standards, tooling, and processes you help establish will influence how models get built for a long time to come.

This is intentionally a hybrid role. At many companies, data science and ML infrastructure are split into separate functions: data scientists author and train models, while a dedicated platform team owns deployment, observability, and retraining. At Rho, we need someone who can do both, someone who can build the model and reason clearly about how it gets deployed, monitored, and retrained in production. You'll work on high-leverage problems like our transaction coding suggestion engine, OCR/document understanding pipeline, and RAG-based and agentic systems, while also helping build the underlying foundation: evaluation frameworks, model deployment and monitoring practices, and the infrastructure decisions that determine whether ML at Rho is reliable and scalable. This role requires genuine fluency in ML infrastructure and evals, not just modeling - you should be as comfortable discussing feature store design or eval harness architecture with data engineers as you are validating a model's statistical soundness.

Technologies we use for data: Python, Snowflake, DBT, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, MLflow, Terraform, Prometheus, Google Cloud Services, Omni, Hex, PowerBI

Responsibilities:

- Help define and evolve Rho's ML/DS practices: how models get evaluated, deployed, monitored, versioned, and retrained

- Design and implement evaluation frameworks and eval harnesses that give the company real confidence in model quality, before and after launch

- Build and own high-impact models and analyses powering products like transaction coding suggestions, OCR/document understanding, and RAG/agentic systems

- Make and document key ML infrastructure decisions (model registries, feature stores, serving patterns, monitoring/alerting for drift and degradation) in close partnership with data engineering

- Set technical standards and best practices that help the ML/DS practice scale as the team grows

- Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped modeling questions

- Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, causal inference) to validate model impact rigorously

- Advocate for and drive adoption of ML infrastructure and tooling improvements as needs grow

Requirements:

- 6+ years of experience in data science, applied ML, or a related quantitative field, with a track record of shipping models into production

- Deep, hands-on understanding of ML infrastructure: model registries, feature stores, serving architectures, monitoring/observability for models, and retraining pipelines

- Strong experience designing evaluation frameworks and evals for ML systems;, including offline metrics and ongoing production evaluation

- Comfortable operating as a hybrid DS/infrastructure practitioner:, someone who doesn't hand a model off to a platform team and walk away, but who can own it end to end when needed

- Experience helping establish or mature ML practices, standards, or infrastructure within a team and company

- Strong programming skills in Python, with solid SQL

- Comfortable making infrastructure trade-off decisions jointly with data/platform engineers, and able to speak credibly on both the modeling and systems sides

- Experience with statistical modeling, machine learning techniques, and experiment design

- Excellent communication skills; able to influence technical direction and bring both technical and non-technical stakeholders along

Nice To Haves:

- Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Gene

title: Regional Sales Director - Enterprise, Florida

As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate -we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Regional Sales Director in the state of Florida reporting to the RVP in the Sales and Go-to-Market department. As a Regional Sales Director, you will lead and build high-performing sales teams, driving customer delight and secure cloud transformation within your assigned region. You will contribute to Zscaler's position as a leader in cloud security by fostering trusted partnerships and leveraging expertise across various go-to-market functions.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Recruit, hire and develop world-class sales talent, build development plans for each sales rep, and coach and motivate sales team to overachieve on targets

• Understand and solve customer pain points through Zscaler's unique value proposition

• Be the GM of your business and create a plan for success, and accurately forecast business monthly/quarterly/yearly

• Act as the executive sponsor for key partners to create joint plans, generate pipeline and drive opportunities to closure

Who You Are (Preferred Qualifications)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

職務概要

Snowflakeでは、技術力、顧客志向、そしてAIを活用した業務遂行能力を兼ね備えたSenior Cloud Support Engineerを募集しています。

24時間365日のテクニカルサポート環境での業務経験、エスカレーション対応、オンコール対応、インシデントマネジメントの経験をお持ちの方を歓迎します。

 
 

主な業務内容

SENIOR CLOUD SUPPORT ENGINEER として、お客様からのお問い合わせ（ケース）を管理し、解決までの時間の短縮、プラットフォームの安定性の確保、および世界最高水準のサポート体験の提供に責任を負います。本ポジションは、幅広い技術領域に対応するテクニカルサポート担当者として、高度な実践的トラブルシューティング能力に加え、お客様から信頼されるアドバイザーとしての共感力とコミュニケーション能力を備えた役割です。

顧客価値の提供とインシデントオーナーシップ

顧客体験の向上 : お客様からのお問い合わせについて、初期調査から解決、その後のフォローアップまで一貫して担当し、適切なコミュニケーションとタイムリーな状況共有を行います。

AIを活用したサポート : AIアシスタントや診断ツールを活用し、初動対応や根本原因分析を効率化します。

成果重視の問題解決 : 単なる事象解消に留まらず、再発防止やシステムの信頼性向上を意識したサポートを提供します。

顧客対応 : メール、Web会議、電話などを通じて技術的な分析やアドバイスを提供し、お客様の技術レベルに応じたコミュニケーションを行います。

 
 

技術対応と社内連携

AIを活用した調査 : AIを利用してログ分析、仮説立案、回答案作成を行い、その内容を適切に検証したうえでお客様へ提供します。

技術調査 : Snowflake環境、コネクタ、社内ツールなどを活用し、問題の調査・検証を実施します。

部門横断での連携 : Engineering、Product、Customer Successチームと連携し、複雑な問題や製品課題の解決に取り組みます。

ナレッジ管理 : ナレッジベースに解決策を登録するとともに、AIが作成したドラフトをレビューし、必要に応じて修正します。

フィードバックと改善提案 : 製品の動作、ドキュメントの不足、およびAIツールの改善点などについてフィードバックを提供します。

バグ管理 : 不具合や機能改善要望を文書化し、Engineeringチームと連携して問題の解決に取り組みます。

サポート体制への参加 : 祝日・週末のローテーション勤務およびオンコール対応を行います。

 
 

勤務条件

- 12:00～21:00（休憩1時間）のシフト勤務が可能であること

- 業務状況に応じて、勤務時間やシフトを変更する場合があります

 
 

必須となる経験・スキル

- 5年以上のテクニカルサポート経験（顧客対応経験必須）

- 24時間365日サポート環境での業務経験がある方歓迎

- AIツールを活用した業務経験

- AIの出力内容を適切に評価・検証できる能力

- 必要に応じてAIに依存せず、自ら調査・分析できる能力

- SQLを利用した問題解析経験

- ログ分析経験

title: Software Engineer, Vulnerability Management
description:
Who we are
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
In this role, you would join Stripe 's Vulnerability Management team, whose mission is to "Surface vulnerabilities at scale across Stripe ." Our vision is to create a culture of continuous excellence in managing vulnerabilities. We want to enhance customer trust by giving users context about threats and vulnerabilities affecting Stripe 's systems. We aim to be a key partner in Stripe 's risk management by providing visibility into vulnerabilities across Stripe 's products and services.
What you’ll do
As a Software Engineer focused on Vulnerability Management at Stripe , you will use your software engineering expertise to find and prioritize vulnerabilities in our systems. Working closely with engineers across the company, you will drive the timely remediation of discovered vulnerabilities, playing a key role in Stripe 's overall security and risk strategy.
In addition, you will continuously improve Stripe 's security defenses by enhancing our vulnerability management processes and selecting effective scanning tools to uncover weaknesses.
Your core responsibilities as a Vulnerability Management Software Engineer will involve building data- and agent-backed systems to surface vulnerabilities across Stripe . In addition, you will coordinate fixes to prevent exploits that could impact Stripe or our users and serve as an advisor on security risks. All of this requires collaborating cross-functionally to advocate for practices that strengthen the safety of Stripe 's systems and data.
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Responsibilities

• Identify vulnerabilities using automated tools and triage them appropriately

• Collaborate with other teams to drive remediation of vulnerabilities

• Contribute to our overall security and risk management strategy

• Continuously improve our security posture, processes, and tools

Minimum requirements

• 2+ years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)

• Software engineering experience within the security domain

• Empathy, strong communication skills and a deep respect for the power of collaboration

• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail

• High standards for code quality and a constructive attitude to help others raise the bar

Preferred qualifications

• An ability to think creatively and holistically about reducing risk in a complex environment

• Familiarity with automated vulnerability identification tools and triage

• Delivery of successful projects using agents to automate human review processes

By joining our team, you will have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach, securely.

description:
Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd., is a global pharmaceutical company based in Japan with operations in the U.S. (Sumitomo Pharma America, Inc.), focused on addressing patient needs in oncology, urology, women's health, rare diseases, cell & gene therapies and CNS. With several marketed products and a diverse pipeline of early- to late-stage investigational assets, we aim to accelerate discovery, research, and development to bring novel therapies to patients sooner. For more information on SMPA, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.
Job Overview:
This position reports to the Director, Access and Reimbursement and is part of the Market Access team, supporting SMPA’s Commercial Organization. This role serves as a field-based position responsible for supporting patient access to therapy by educating healthcare providers, office staff, health systems, and key stakeholders on reimbursement, coverage, coding, billing, and patient support programs. These roles serve as a subject matter expert on payer policies, access barriers, prior authorization requirements, claims adjudication, appeals processes, and patient affordability solutions, helping providers and staff navigate the complexities of obtaining appropriate patient access to prescribed therapies while maintaining compliance with all applicable legal, regulatory, and company standards. We are hiring four remote positions covering four main geographies: West, Central, Northeast and Southeast.
In this role, you will partner cross-functionally with Market Access, Account Management, Patient Services, Sales, Medical Affairs, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to identify and address reimbursement challenges that impact patient initiation, adherence, and continuity of care.
Essential Functions Required for Job
Reimbursement Education & Support

• Serve as the field-based expert on reimbursement, coverage, coding, billing, claims submission, appeals, and patient access processes.

• Educate healthcare providers, office managers, reimbursement specialists, and health system stakeholders on payer requirements and reimbursement pathways.

• Provide compliant education regarding benefit verification, prior authorization requirements, appeal processes, coding updates, and coverage policies.

• Assist providers in understanding patient support programs, affordability solutions, and HUB resources.

Patient Access Strategy

• Identify reimbursement and access barriers affecting patient treatment initiation and persistence.

• Develop and execute territory-level access plans to address market-specific reimbursement challenges.

• Monitor payer policy changes, coverage restrictions, utilization management criteria, and emerging reimbursement trends.

• Collaborate with Market Access and Patient Services teams to improve the customer experience and patient journey.

Customer Engagement

• Build trusted relationships with physician practices, academic centers, integrated delivery networks, community providers, specialty pharmacies, and injection/infusion centers.

• Deliver educational presentations regarding reimbursement processes and access support resources.

• Respond to complex reimbursement inquiries and escalate unresolved issues through appropriate channels.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Corporate Account Directors, Regional Account Directors, Market Access Marketing, Patient Services, Trade, Medical Affairs, and Commercial leadership to identify systemic access issues and recommend solutions.

• Provide field insights related to payer coverage, claims trends, reimbursement obstacles, and customer needs.

• Support product launches and new indication expansions through access readiness planning and field reimbursement education.

Compliance & Governance

• Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with healthcare laws, industry guidance, corporate compliance policies, and applicable promotional/non-promotional standards.

• Maintain accurate activity documentation

title: Small Business Ownership – Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
Are you a current small business owner or manager eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of supporting entrepreneurs with operations, strategy, financial planning, and customer engagement. With high-quality training data grounded in real-world business experience, tomorrow’s AI can better serve Small Business owners and managers navigating limited resources and high-stakes decisions. That training data begins with you-we need your practical expertise to help power the next generation of AI.
We’re looking for current owners, co-owners, and managers across a range of industries, including retail, e-commerce, professional services such as consulting, legal, and accounting, technology and software, hospitality and food and beverage, healthcare and wellness, creative and media, construction and trades, and other small business sectors. Whether you are a new business owner or have years of operational experience, your insight into day-to-day decision-making is highly valuable.
On a typical day, you will engage the model with realistic small business scenarios and operational challenges; evaluate outputs related to budgeting, pricing, marketing strategy, hiring decisions, vendor management, customer communications, and basic compliance considerations; assess whether responses are practical and aligned with how Very Small Businesses actually operate; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation criteria, and real-world applicability. You may also help identify where models oversimplify trade-offs or misunderstand resource constraints common to VSB environments.
Direct experience owning or co-owning a small business is strongly preferred. Experience managing operations, finances, marketing, staffing, or growth strategy is highly relevant. Entry-level business owners as well as seasoned entrepreneurs are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication-explicitly articulating how and why decisions are made in a real business context-is essential.
Ready to turn your small business ownership experience into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that better support entrepreneurs worldwide.
We offer a pay range of $20 to $100 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: Custom Jewelry Gem Specialist
description:
Custom Jewelry Gem Specialist

ABOUT THE COMPANY

At CustomMade , we believe engagement rings should be as personal as the relationships they represent. We make it easy to create a ring that's both one-of-a-kind and affordable. Turns out people really like that and word is really spreading quickly! We've created 30,000 pieces of custom jewelry and helped 12,000 couples get engaged, but we're still just getting started reshaping the jewelry industry.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Our offering is built on a one-on-one, specialized, and custom design experience and service. As a Custom Jewelry Gem Specialist, you'll be at the heart of our gem sourcing process, responsible for selecting and procuring the right stone for each customer's project. You'll serve as the company's internal gem expert and primary decision-maker on stone selection, gem procurement, supplier management, and gem quality - supporting our customer-facing teams on all things related to gems.

This role's primary duties involve: gem sourcing and selection, purchasing and procurement, supplier (vendor) management, and quality assurance for stones. You'll be evaluated primarily on your ability to select stones that fit each customer's budget and preferences while meeting our quality standard. Because every project is custom, no two sourcing decisions are identical - you'll exercise significant discretion and independent judgment in evaluating options across our supplier network, weighing quality against cost, and making purchasing and quality decisions that directly impact customers and the business.

Essential role duties look like:

Gem sourcing & selection

• Evaluate stones across our supplier network and select the options presented to customers, applying gem expertise and judgment on quality, value, and fit with the customer's budget and preferences.

• Serve as the internal authority on gems - advising Project Managers and customers, and resolving gem-related questions and concerns on behalf of the company.

• Exercise judgment in high-stakes situations - for example, a stone that fails inspection, breaks in setting, or becomes unavailable close to a customer's deadline - including deciding among substitution, re-sourcing, or customer communication strategies.

Purchasing & procurement

• Make purchasing decisions for center stones and other gems, selecting the stone and supplier within company guidelines.

• Manage the procurement pipeline from order through delivery and storage, coordinating with suppliers and our in-office team.

• Identify and resolve procurement issues - delays, out-of-stock items, and reorders for stones that break in setting - and determine when project plans need to be adjusted.

• Purchase inventory stones, deciding what to stock based on demand, pricing, and supplier availability.

Supplier management

• Manage the company's day-to-day relationships with gem suppliers, including supplier performance, responsiveness, and quality.

• Identify, evaluate, and onboard new gem suppliers to strengthen our sourcing network.

• Review supplier invoices for accuracy, approve them for payment, and resolve invoicing discrepancies with suppliers.

Quality assurance

• Evaluate stones against our quality standards and determine whether they are acceptable for use in customer projects.

• Determine the appropriate resolution for gem quality issues - accepting, returning, or replacing a stone - and negotiate remediation with suppliers.

• Investigate and resolve customer concerns regarding stones, deciding on the appropriate remedy on behalf of the company.

Pricing & continuous improvement

• Review and update our gem estimates and pricing to ensure they are accurate and cost-competitive, recommending changes to management.

• Evaluate, recommend, and implement improvements to our sourcing, procurement, and quality processes; update internal gem guidance based on project experience.

• Advise management on supplier performance, market pricing trends,

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. About the Role:
The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of the company's software products. This role involves close collaboration with product and engineering teams to define clear acceptance criteria, develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, and build robust automated testing frameworks for a modern web application and its backend services. The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle.
What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer:
-

• Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria.

• Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases.

• Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests.

• Performs manual testing for complex or new features prior to the establishment of full automation coverage.

• Monitors, analyzes, and improves test coverage, reliability, and performance over time.

• Contributes to the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) process by integrating automated tests into the deployment pipeline.

• Enhances overall product quality by creating detailed bug reports, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear testing documentation.

• Designs and deploys AI-assisted testing workflows to automate recurring tasks such as test case generation, test data synthesis, and log analysis.

• Evaluates and integrates LLM-based testing and coding tools into the QA team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for automated testing and edge-case discovery use cases.

Experience and skills required:
-

• Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer (5+ Years of experience) or similar role, specifically testing modern web applications and backend services.

• Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools.

• Deep understanding of backend services, APIs (REST and GraphQL), and their common failure scenarios.

• Ability to read and comprehend frontend and backend code to assist in debugging and test creation.

• Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools and processes.

• Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) and demonstrated ability to build, deploy, or thoroughly validate agent-assisted testing systems in a near-production context.

• Proactive and highly detail-oriented mindset.

• Advanced proficiency in the English language.

Your job is finding them early and keeping the commercial relationship in step with the usage, including renewals and consumption commitments.

New business usually starts with a team already running ClickHouse - open source, or a Cloud account someone expensed - until a bill or a security review pushes the conversation up to the platform team and the budget owner. - Grow your install base by landing new teams and new use cases inside accounts that already buy from us.

- Own renewals and consumption commitments, working with your Solutions Architect and Support to get ahead of usage and churn risk.

- Watch consumption trends across your accounts and engage early when usage flattens or spikes. Both are signals.

- Find and convert existing ClickHouse usage in new accounts. Unmanaged open-source deployments and self-serve Cloud accounts are the highest-yield source of new pipeline in this segment.

• Comfortable operating with ambiguity. You don’t need every process to be defined before you can move forward

• Creative and curious, always looking for better and more unconventional ways to find and attract great people

How we work

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python) - Remote
description:
Breathment is a Munich-based digital health startup. We digitize pulmonary rehabilitation for people living with chronic respiratory diseases such as COPD: our app guides patients through therapy exercises at home, watches their movement through the phone camera and gives feedback in real time, while physiotherapists and physicians follow their progress remotely through our telemonitoring platform. We work with German clinics, physiotherapists and health insurers, and every release reaches real patients.
We are looking for a senior engineer who is at home in both worlds: computer vision and production backend. You will own the path from neural-network output to what the patient sees on screen and what the therapist reads in the report.
Tasks

Own the computer-vision pipeline that turns pose-estimation output from our neural networks into repetition counts, posture feedback and set-by-set exercise analysis.
Design the reporting layer that converts raw movement data into clinical reports physiotherapists act on.
Build and extend our Python backend (FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis): the API behind the patient app and the clinician platform.
Ship to production on Kubernetes with GPU inference services, and stand behind what you ship: tests, monitoring and clean handovers.
Analyse requirements together with product, physiotherapists and the mobile team, and propose solutions instead of waiting for tickets.

Requirements

5+ years of professional software development in Python, including production REST APIs (FastAPI or comparable).
Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow). You have built real product features on top of model output, not only trained models in notebooks.
Solid experience with NoSQL databases, ideally MongoDB, and with data models that survive growth.
A fluent Git and GitHub workflow: branches, reviews, CI.

title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (UK)
description:
We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule.

- Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion.

- Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn.

- Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies.

- Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined.

This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions.

QUALIFICATIONS:

- Registration: Registered radiologist in your country of practice with active license

- Experience: 3-10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus

- Knowledge: Strong grounding in thoracic anatomy and cross-sectional CT.

- Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in image review or measurement work.

- Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms.

- Prior imaging annotation experience is an advantage but not required.

- Language: Native or near-native written English.

LEGAL STATUS:

- You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

- You will work as an independent contractor.

WHY JOIN US?

- Flexible Work Arrangements: Part-time, remote and fully asynchronous.

- Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate, paid weekly.

- Professional Development: Hands-on experience in clinical AI development and medical imaging, shaping how AI systems localise and measure findings on CT.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and trustworthy products across AlphaSense's AI-native platform. You'll work closely with architects, engineering, and product teams to embed security by design throughout the software development lifecycle.

This role sits at the intersection of AI/ML security, secure architecture, threat modeling, and customer-facing assurance - defining the standards, automation, and frameworks that enable secure, intelligent products at scale.

What You’ll Do:

AI Security & Enablement (30%)

• Architect and enforce security controls for AI/ML systems - model training, data pipelines, inference environments, and agentic workflows.

• Identify and mitigate AI-specific attack vectors: prompt injection, data poisoning, model inversion, model theft.

• Implement model provenance, integrity, and auditability controls for responsible, secure AI operations.

• Align AI security with governance and compliance teams against frameworks like NIST AI RMF and the EU AI Act.

Secure Architecture & Development Lifecycle (30%)

• Embed security throughout the software and AI development lifecycle, partnering with architects, engineering, and product across AlphaSense's application and cloud ecosystems.

• Ensure security, privacy, and compliance by design.

• Define and maintain secure development standards, guidance, and best practices.

Threat Modeling & Security Review (20%)

• Lead threat modeling, secure design reviews, and risk assessments across the software development lifecycle.

• Build and maintain security automation and governance that integrates into development workflows.

Customer-Facing Security Assurance (10%)

• Produce customer-facing security assurance - security questionnaire responses, security whitepapers, and trust collateral - that unblocks enterprise deals.

• Represent product security in customer, cross-functional, and leadership discussions.

Leadership (10%)

• Mentor teams on secure coding, AI risk management, and secure design.

• Promote a security-first culture through advocacy, documentation, and training.

What We Are Looking For: 

• 5-7+ years in product, application, or cloud security engineering.

• Deep understanding of secure SDLC, threat modeling, and secure architecture design.

• Ability to read and review code to inform threat models and design reviews.

• Experience securing AI/ML pipelines, data workflows, and model-serving infrastructure, with working knowledge of AI/LLM security (prompt injection, model integrity, provenance).

• Proven expertise with cloud security concepts and best practices across multi-cloud environments.

• Familiarity with DevSecOps and CI/CD environments.

• Familiarity with encryption fundamentals - symmetric and asymmetric

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads and software on standardized satellites, and we are building the first marketplace for space-based AI applications: the store where partners publish, deploy, and monetize AI solutions that run on satellites in orbit. title: Product Manager, Growth
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The Customer Growth & Experience (CGX) team owns the full customer lifecycle - from the moment a customer lands on plaid.com http://plaid.com to their journey across onboarding, activation, adoption, and long-term success.

Within CGX, the Growth team owns Plaid's highest-leverage revenue levers. We optimize the self-serve funnel from a customer's first onboarding step through go-live and scale, build the upsell motion that expands existing customers, partner with GTM to remove friction from the sales flow, and own the premium enterprise features that unlock our largest customers. We operate data-first, using funnel analytics and experimentation to find and prioritize the bets that move the business.

As a Product Manager on the Growth team, you'll own one of Plaid's highest-leverage revenue surfaces: the self-serve funnel that takes customers from their first onboarding step through go-live and scale. You'll work to increase acquisition, reduce friction, and improve revenue efficiency across the SMB and long-tail base.

You'll partner closely with the Web team, Engineering, Design, BI/DS, Marketing, and Sales to build the upsell motion that expands existing customers, whether served in-product or routed to GTM as qualified opportunities, and to streamline the handoffs between self-serve and sales-assisted motions. You'll also help shape the enterprise features (e.g., SSO, audit logs) that unlock larger customers.

This role is ideal for a data-driven growth PM who's energized by moving the number quickly through experimentation while placing bigger strategic bets. It's an IC role with significant scope in an active investment area, with high visibility across GTM and Product leadership.

Responsibilities

- Own and optimize the self-serve funnel end to end, from the onboarding flow through go-live and scaling

- Drive scalable SMB and long-tail acquisition: grow new activated customers, reduce onboarding friction, and improve revenue efficiency

- Build the upsell/cross-sell motion, surfacing intelligent recommendations self-serve or as qualified opportunities for GTM

- Partner with GTM to understand the sales and account management flows, find where handoffs break down, and streamline for greater throughput

- Use funnel analytics, segmentation, and experimentation to find, size, and prioritize the highest-leverage bets

- Partner cross-functionally with Web, Engineering, Design, BI/DS, Marketing, and Sales to ship and measure impact

Qualifications

- 5+ years of product management experience

- Experience with product-led growth (PLG) at a B2B or API-first company, including top-of-funnel and activation funnels with quantifiable improvements

- Strong analytical and funnel-optimization skills; comfortable making decisions from experiment and funnel data, and partnering closely with BI/DS

- Track record partnering effectively with GTM teams (Sales, Partnerships, Marketing)

- Experience building acquisition motions for SMB and/or supporting key accounts at scale

- Excellent communication; can articulate tradeoffs clearly to GTM, Engineering, and cross-functional leadership

Nice to Have

- Experience in fintech

- Background in API-fi

title: Director of Business Development - Europe
description:
Role Overview
Driven by surging demand for immersive and volumetric content, as well as new perspectives that can unlock creative storytelling, Muybridge is commercialising a genuinely novel technology platform across sports broadcast, premium studio production, and live entertainment. This comes at a defining moment for the broadcast industry: after decades of relative stability, the convergence of GPU computing, computer vision, and autonomous production is fundamentally reshaping how content is captured, produced, and distributed. The buyers, workflows, and value chains that defined the last generation are being rewritten and Muybridge is at the centre of that shift. This is a rare opportunity to be first in - building a territory, owning a pipeline, and closing landmark deals that define a category.
The Director of Business Development - Europe will be the primary commercial presence across the region. Operating from a home office, you will represent Muybridge independently across a complex, multi-stakeholder value chain: leagues, clubs, venues, broadcasters, production service companies, studio operators, and live event producers. You will carry an annual revenue quota and be expected to over-deliver on it.
Success in this role requires working on two levels simultaneously: managing and developing channel partnerships - the service companies, systems integrators, and broadcast partners through whom deals are often structured and delivered, while also creating demand and building conviction at the top of the value chain with rights holders, leagues, federations, and executive decision-makers. You will be expected to be present at key live deployments, acting as the commercial face of Muybridge on-site, strengthening partner and client relationships in the field, and supporting the deployment team when needed.
This is a senior, self-sufficient role - one for someone equally comfortable in a boardroom and a broadcast truck. You will carry technical conversations with prospects, supported remotely by our technical team, and close enterprise-level deals that often span multiple decision-makers and long sales cycles. You report directly to the CCO.
What You'll Do
Revenue Generation & Channel Partner Development

• Own and manage a structured European pipeline, forecasting accurately and reporting to the CCO on a regular cadence.

• Meet and exceed an annual sales quota through a combination of new logo acquisition and expansion within existing accounts.

• Develop account plans for key strategic targets and execute against them with discipline and creativity.

• Maintain a rigorous and up-to-date record of all conversations, opportunities, and account activity in the company's CRM system, ensuring full pipeline visibility for the leadership team.

• Prepare, submit, and negotiate commercial proposals and offers, managing the full arc from initial qualification through to signed agreement.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once - from our largest metros to our smallest cities.
That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools that sit at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll work on making sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets to hit our goals, help allocate those levers across markets, and dig into problem areas to find and fix root causes. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations - one for someone who's as comfortable building a model as they are diving into why a specific market is off plan.
You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations & courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.
